title: Di’Trillio
type: Seeker · investigator and advocate for the Dasa
dek: An investigator whose promise to find two strangers becomes a commitment to help people choose between refuge and resistance.

facts.Status: Vey and Vaa found; promised refuge and passage still require support

sources: Quest RP refreshed source · supplied 23 October 2026 · 3,845 messages across the main channel and two accessible threads; posting chronology and narrated continuations remain distinct
body:
Di’Trillio’s earlier work with the Seekers includes surviving the haze and investigating the harpy cave. His life with Vessalia gives his later risk a home to return to. The Dasa expedition turns technical investigation toward a political responsibility.

A promise carried beyond the embassy

Kimi and Kuri’s request leads him north from Pristinia with Saoirse, Felicity, Lucien, Alesteir and Vel’kaen. He checks the camp’s perimeter, helps organize watch and insists the company keep an attacker alive. After the surviving Rahu dies before explaining himself, Di’Trillio can establish only that the soldier did not kill himself; the cause remains unknown.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

Duty to the people on either side

He gives the fallen scouts shallow, respectful graves before pressing on. At the mountain refuge he approaches openly with his blades sheathed and bows to the siblings as equals. When Vey and Vaa distinguish their own purpose from an uprising, he corrects his assumption before offering more.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4.

Becoming a bridge

He offers to seek Melian and the town elders’ support, help people who wish to leave and prepare a base for those who wish to resist. Eovar’s ships and a possible safehouse enter the discussion as practical needs. He accepts a sending stone and a night’s hospitality.

His pledge is witnessed. The town has not thereby approved his proposals, and the promised building, safehouse arrangements and departures are not shown complete.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

People behind the work

Vessalia is his partner; he tells Felicity they are enjoying their new home. Felicity reminds him he has someone to return to. Saoirse adds offers of aid despite exhaustion. The siblings become contacts rather than merely names in someone else’s request.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4.
